issues.where: Part 4(b) exemplar vs Part 4 prompt and Lesson 1/Lesson 9 data
issues.problem: Part 4(b) prompt asks to explain Amina's Mombasa case 'using the humidity figures' and the exemplar claims the balloon sticks 'under 30 seconds or not at all' at 80%. Lesson 1 says only that it 'hardly works' and is 'weak or absent'; the under-30-seconds figure appears only in Lesson 9. This is a minor mismatch, not a contradiction, so it is not a defect.

issues.where: Lesson 5 vs Lesson 6/Lesson 8 (electroscope leaf at about 30 degrees when strip only near)
issues.problem: Lesson 5 says a negative strip touching the cap leaves the leaf at about 30 degrees, and the same about 30 degrees when the strip was only near. Lesson 8 says the leaf stays at about 30 degrees after contact, and Lesson 6 gives induction-with-earthing leaving the leaf at about 30 degrees with the opposite sign. Equal angles for near, contact and induced charge are physically unrealistic: contact charge should be more permanent and typically give a different value than the removed-strip induction case. The lessons do not contradict each other numerically.
